I have only this small piece of 0.08 hectares for my cassava, and chemical fertilizer is too costly for me to buy this season, so I will rely on what I have at home. I will spread manure from my goats and chickens on the plot before planting, and I will use cuttings from my own local cassava because they have always done well here and I do not need to spend money on new seed. My children and I will weed the plot by hand when the weeds come up after the rains, and since the land is small, we can manage all the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
